main_body: A dark stone throne with a tall pointed backrest, a red cushion seat, and a stepped base, all drawn straight from the front.
top_band: none. Column x=8 runs from the backrest finial (gold, rows 0-1) through dark backrest rows 2-17, then red cushion rows 18-21 and a gold edge at row 22. No lighter horizontal top surface sits above a front face.
evidence: The seat is a front-facing red cushion block, rows 18-21, with a gold lip on row 22. It is 4 rows of graded red, but it reads as a vertical face seen head-on, like the backrest panel above it. No lighter horizontal seat surface is visible from above. The backrest, armrests and base are all flat front views. This matches the guide's red 'front elevation' and 'thin seat' drawings, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has 18 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, though its median of 16 per tile is close to theirs. 96% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 1% and 33% in the references. The outline and body are near-black neutral (#131317, #1e1e24, #2a2a32) with no material tint, which gives a sticker look. The dark stone is a few near-identical dark steps with almost no grain or per-stone shading. The red cushion ramp and gold trim are well graded, but the main body is shallow and flat compared with the references.
